responsibility: Defines the shared structured-diagnostic interface and reexports the concrete HIR-analysis diagnostic builders for richer, context-sensitive errors. This root file unifies the reusable `StructuredDiag` trait with the specific builders for variadic-argument cast errors, sized-to-unsized cast errors, and wrong generic-argument-count diagnostics so checking and type-lowering code can construct regular or `--teach`-extended error messages consistently.
